title: Build a Sapper and make rubber
description: Tap a living tree for Resin, then pipe it into a heated Compressor for your first Raw Rubber. This setup supplies the rubber you need for Sealed Mechanisms.

materials.label: Oak Sapling
materials.description: Grow a tree and keep its leaves. A grown Oak, Birch or Biomes O' Plenty Maple also works.

materials.label: Fluid Pipe
materials.description: Connect the Sapper to the Compressor through the pump.

materials.label: Cogwheel
materials.description: Drive the Sapper and route rotation to the pump and Compressor.

materials.label: Shaft
materials.description: Use enough shafts to connect your machines to rotational power.

materials.label: Water Wheel
materials.description: Optional. Use one if you have no nearby rotation.

materials.label: Campfire
materials.description: Light it directly below the Compressor.

materials.label: Depot
materials.description: Catch the Raw Rubber. A Create Belt also works.

materials.label: Andesite Machine
materials.description: If crafting the Sapper and Compressor, stonecut one for each.

steps.title: Leave a gap in front of the Sapper
steps.text: Stonecut an Andesite Machine into a Sapper. Place it two blocks from the lowest trunk block, with its working face toward the trunk and one empty block between them for the head to extend. Keep the matching leaves on the grown tree. Run a Cogwheel into the side of the Sapper to power it.

steps.title: Pump Resin out the back
steps.text: Connect a Fluid Pipe to the side opposite the tree. Add a powered Mechanical Pump with its arrow pointing away from the Sapper and run the line into the back of a Compressor. Stonecut another Andesite Machine to get the Compressor. Feeding it directly lets you make rubber before you have the Sealed Mechanism needed for a Fluid Tank.

figure.alt: A grown tree stands one air block in front of the Sapper. The rear pipe feeds a powered pump, which pushes Resin into a Compressor above a Campfire to make Raw Rubber.

steps.title: Make and cure the rubber
steps.text: Place a lit Campfire immediately below the Compressor. Drive its side shaft so it turns clockwise when viewed from the Compressor's right side. Put a Depot or Belt one block in front of the Compressor and one block lower to catch the output. The Compressor turns 500 mB of Resin into one Raw Rubber. Cure it in a Smoker to get one Cured Rubber.

tips.title: Pick a supported tree
tips.text: Oak gives 25 mB of Resin per cycle and Birch gives 40 mB. Red, orange and yellow Biomes O' Plenty Maples each give 150 mB. Use one Sapper per tree for a full yield since Sappers sharing a trunk split each cycle's Resin.

tips.title: If Resin stops moving
tips.text: Check that the Sapper has a clear gap and living leaves, then check that the pump is powered and points toward the Compressor. If the Compressor has Resin but sits idle, check its rotation and the Campfire beneath it.
